description_en: Creates and issues an external subordinate CA certificate based on a CSR and API parameters
description_zh: 基于CSR和API参数创建并颁发外部子CA证书
kebab_example: aliyun cas create-external-ca-certificate --instance-id cas_deposit-cn-1234abcd --csr example-string --validity 10y --api-passthrough '{"Extensions":{"PathLenConstraint":0,"ExtendedKeyUsages":["serverAuth"]},"Subject":{"Organization":"Alibaba","Locality":"Hangzhou","State":"Zhejiang","OrganizationUnit":"Cloud_Security","Country":"CN","CommonName":"Testing_CA"}}' --tags Value=1 Key=database --resource-group-id test --cert-max-time 30 --api-version 2020-06-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateExternalCACertificate

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the external subordinate CA instance to activate
parameters.help_zh: 需要启用的外部子CA实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The certificate signing request. The CSR can contain the SubjectDN and custom extensions of the CA certificate. The SubjectKeyIdentifier, AuthorityKeyIdentifier, and CRLDistributionPoints certificate extensions are generated by the CA, and the values in the CSR are ignored
parameters.help_zh: 证书签名请求。可包含CA证书的SubjectDN、CA证书自定义扩展项等。SubjectKeyIdentifier、AuthorityKeyIdentifier、CRLDistributionPoints证书扩展项由CA生成，CSR中的值会被忽略
parameters.name: csr

parameters.help_en:
The certificate validity period. Both relative time and absolute time are supported.

Relative time: Supports the units of year, month, and day.

Year - y
Month - m
Day - d

Absolute time: Uses GMT time. Format: `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'`

Specify the end time - `$NotAfter`
Specify the start time and end time - `$NotBefore/$NotAfter`
parameters.help_zh:
证书有效期。支持使用相对时间和绝对时间。

相对时间：支持单位年、月、日。

年 - y
月 - m
日 - d

绝对时间：使用 GMT 时间。格式：`yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'`

指定结束时间 - `$NotAfter`
指定开始时间和结束时间 - `$NotBefore/$NotAfter`
parameters.name: validity

fields.help_en: The certificate path length constraint. For an EndEntity CA, this value must be set to 0, which means the current CA certificate is used to issue end entity certificates
fields.help_zh: 证书路径长度限制。EndEntity CA 该值必须传0，即当前CA证书用于颁发End Entity证书
fields.name: path_len_constraint

fields.help_en: The CA certificate extensions. If this value is specified, it overrides the extension values in the CSR or adds them to the CA certificate extensions
fields.help_zh: CA证书扩展。该值存在时会覆盖CSR中的扩展项值，或添加到CA证书扩展项中
fields.name: extensions

fields.help_en: The name of the current CA certificate
fields.name: common_name

fields.help_en: The country. Uses the ISO 3166-1 two-letter country code
fields.help_zh: 所属国家。使用ISO 3166-1的二位国家代码
fields.name: country

fields.help_en: The organizational unit within the organization, such as a department, team, project group, or branch
fields.help_zh: 所属组织内部的子单位（部门、团队、项目组或分支机构）
fields.name: organization_unit

fields.help_en: The subject information of the CA certificate. If this value is specified, it overrides the SubjectDN in the CSR
fields.help_zh: CA证书主体信息。该值存在时会覆盖CSR中的SubjectDN
fields.name: subject

parameters.help_en: Overrides CSR content or adds content to the CA certificate through API parameters
parameters.help_zh: 通过API参数覆盖CSR内容或添加到CA证书中
parameters.name: api_passthrough

parameters.help_en: The maximum validity period for issued certificates, as specified by the certMaxTime of the CA. Unit: days
parameters.help_zh: 签发证书的最长时间由CA的certMaxTime指定。单位：天
parameters.name: cert_max_time

Identifier.description_en: The unique identifier of the certificate
